plain.li: [trail] There's a coin, and another, all the way out to the edge.
[trail] Somebody's silver walked out of the store on its own, look at the line.
[trail] Coins in a row out the door, like they were leaving.
[trail,named] {GOD} doesn't like it sitting still, that's where it went.
[trail,scoffer] Someone's sack had a hole in it, follow it and we'll find who.
[purse] Take it, {OTHER}, gold has to keep moving.
[purse] For the road, {OTHER}, and I won't take it back.
[purse,named] {GOD}'s day, {OTHER}, so the coin goes to you.
[purse,scoffer] Here, {OTHER}, call it good manners if you like.
[beetle] The beetle went under there, and there's a gold coin.
[beetle] I followed a little gold beetle and look what was at the end of it.
[beetle,named] {GOD} showed me where it was, the beetle walked me right to it.
[beetle,scoffer] Somebody dropped this, and a beetle happened to be crawling past.
